name: Digital Modulation
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A carrier driven by a framed packet of dibits through a four-point constellation, with an openable frame.

controls.label: Frame
controls.description: Shortens the packet frame from a long header to a rapid burst.

controls.label: Symbol rate
controls.description: Raises the symbol rate from a slow stutter to a buzzing carrier.

controls.label: Shaping
controls.description: Shapes the symbol transitions from hard steps to smooth glides.

controls.label: Payload
controls.description: Sweeps the payload byte around the stock packet contents.
